title: 2. NIST IR Lifecycle (SP 800-61)
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L20: Incident Response: 2. NIST IR Lifecycle (SP 800-61).

blocks.text: NIST defines a 4-phase lifecycle (also taught as 6-phase PICERL):

rows: IR plan, playbooks, team training, tools, contacts
Triage alerts, classify severity, scope incident
Confirm: is this real? How bad?
Stop spread, remove threat, restore systems

blocks.text: Note: NIST released SP 800-61 Rev. 3 in April 2025, which maps IR to CSF 2.0 Functions (GOVERN, IDENTIFY, PROTECT, DETECT, RESPOND, RECOVER). The phases are unchanged in practice; Rev. 3 emphasizes IR as part of risk management, not standalone.
`` P — Preparation I — Identification (= Detection & Analysis) C — Containment E — Eradication R — Recovery L — Lessons Learned ``
